Alex Lee: FYI — KP Logistics sent an update on the APAC allocation. Lead times slipping; they propose a hybrid commit + top-off loaners. Need decision by EOD for Q2 routing.

KP Logistics (Vendor): Confirming. Current windows: sea ETA 2025-05-12—05-20, air ETA 2025-04-30—05-02. Customs backlog at SIN port adds 48–72h. We can do partial air conversion for 8 units (processing +48h) if you cover expedite +$3k/unit.

Maya Rodriguez: @KP Logistics can you confirm whether loaner pool can cover 10 H100s while the reserved batch ships? We prefer loaners vs conversion if costs similar.

KP Logistics (Vendor): Loaner pool: 6 H100s available immediately in SIN hub, 4 more available in SG on Monday. For RMA/loaners we need serials and CMAs. Brokerage consolidated reduces fees ~25%.

Samir Patel: If we accept 6 loaners now and top-off 4 by air, can you lock pricing for the committed 20 units for 60 days? Also we need to avoid split AWBs where possible.

KP Logistics (Vendor): Price lock = yes for committed units once PO and 30% deposit received; 60-day lock +$0. No problem to consolidate AWBs — but RMA routing needs explicit consent on whether to route via FRA or direct APAC.

Alex Lee: We're okay with consolidation. We'll send serials + PO by noon. One more ask: can you provide AWB placeholders so we can update our tracking?

KP Logistics (Vendor): AWB placeholders:
```
AWB: 772-ABCD123456
AWB: 772-ABCD123457
Serials: H100-0001..H100-0010
```
We'll replace with final AWBs after customs clearance. Note: consolidating EU transit adds a customs re-doc step (+24–48h).

VendorOps Bot: Shipment note created: https://track.kpl/log/772-ABCD123456 — assigned manifest ID kpl-man-5567. :white_check_mark:

Maya Rodriguez: OK thanks — @Samir I'll take point on deposit PO. Alex — I'll reconcile serials and post them in #eng-runtime.

Alex Lee: :thumbsup: Sending serials now in DM to KP Logistics and will post a redacted list in #vendors.
